B ROUTER & ARBITER (u_bsel : xbar_rsp_sel)

• Route check: b_route[t] = t_bvalid[t] && w_id_busy[t] [t_bid[t]]
• Candidate: b_cand[m][t] = b_route[t] && (w_id_own[t][t_bid[t]] == m)
• Error sink: if (t_bvalid[t] && !b_route[t]) t_bready[t] = 1
• Done: b_done[t] = t_bvalid[t] && t_bready[t] && b_route[t]

xbar_req_ctrl - One xbar_req_ctrl instance handles one target. 
Separate instances are used for AW and AR, and instantiated for each internal target (T0, T1, T2).. AW = u_aw_ctrl, AR = u_ar_ctrl, each has NT = 3 of these (T0, T2, T1). All state is kept per (target, ID).

t_done[t] · t_done_id[t]
B hs / last R beat + its BID / RID

1 · QUALIFY (per target t, per master m, ID i = m_id[m])

  • elsewhere = m's ID i is busy at ANOTHER target
  • taken = (t, i) is busy and owned by the OTHER master
  • full = cnt[t][i] >= MAXOUT (8)
  • drain = m owns (t, i) AND other master wants (t, i)
req[t][m] = m_valid[m] & (m_tgt[m]==t) & m_ok[m] & t_ok[t]
& !elsewhere & !taken & !full & !drain

READY back to masters
m_ready[m] = OR over t of
( gnt[t][m] AND t_ready[t] )

hs[t] = ( |gnt[t] ) AND t_ready[t]
hid = m_id[ granted master ]
(request accepted by the target)

done[t] = t_done[t] AND id_busy[t][t_done_id[t]]
(response finished for that ID)

Outstanding Counter and Ownership Table

4 · STATE per target t, per ID (16 IDs, flip-flops, async reset)

cnt[t][id] 4-bit outstanding count:

id_own[t][id] = granted master, captured on the first handshake when cnt[t][id] == 0; retained until cnt[t][id] returns to 0.

  • cnt[t][id]: increments on an accepted AW/AR handshake for that target and ID.

  • cnt[t][id]: decrements when the corresponding B response or final R beat is accepted.

  • id_busy[t][id] = (cnt[t][id] != 0)


    • last, lock, lock_m flops are drawn above, next to the
    mux each one selects. id_busy / id_own / cnt also go back
    to QUALIFY (orange tag).

id_own[NT-1:0][15:0]
→ B / R: which master owns the ID

Reading the chain (one request)
1. QUALIFY makes req[t][1:0] from the (target, ID) tables.
2. RR mux picks the master that did NOT win last.
3. ARB mux: both ask → RR result, else req itself.
4. LOCK mux keeps the same master until the target is READY.
5. GRANT mux = lock ? locked master : ARB result.
6. hs: cnt[t][hid]+1 · done: cnt[t][t_done_id]-1.
T2 - DECERR responder (internal 3rd target: answers every out-of-range address with DECERR = 2'b11)
Write side AW + W in, one B out per burst

id FIFO (xbar_fifo, depth 8)
width = ID_WIDTH = 4
din = t_awid[2]
full → t_awready[2] low
dout = oldest pending id

err_wdone (4-bit counter)
+1 when t_wvalid & t_wlast
-1 on B handshake
= bursts waiting for a B

B generator
t_bvalid[2] = ( err_wdone != 0 )
t_bresp[2] = DECERR (2'b11)
t_bid[2] = id FIFO output
err_b_hs = t_bvalid & t_bready
→ pop id FIFO, -1 on err_wdone

B response
t_bid[2][3:0] · t_bresp[2][1:0]
t_bvalid[2] → B MUX M0 / M1
Read side AR in, arlen+1 R beats out

{id,len} FIFO (xbar_fifo, depth 8)
width = ID_WIDTH + 8 = 12
din = {t_arid[2], t_arlen[2]}
full → t_arready[2] low

err_beat (8-bit counter)
+1 on each R beat accepted
reset to 0 after RLAST

R generator
t_rvalid[2] = FIFO not empty
t_rid[2] = FIFO id field
t_rdata[2] = 0
t_rresp[2] = DECERR (2'b11)
t_rlast[2] = ( err_beat == FIFO len )
on rvalid & rready & rlast → pop FIFO

R response
t_rid[2][3:0] · t_rdata[2][63:0]
t_rresp[2][1:0] · t_rlast[2]
t_rvalid[2] → R MUX M0 / M1
last R beat accepted: reset err_beat
last R beat accepted: pop {id,len} FIFO
